title: Submerged: The Ocean Artifact
description: Dive into the deep! Defeat the Ocean Monument guardians to claim "Submerged," a brand-new custom music disc.
body:
# 🔱 Submerged: The Ocean Artifact
Welcome to Submerged, a unique Minecraft mod that brings the mysterious power of the deep ocean straight into your hands! This mod adds an epic multi-step adventure to the ocean depths.

### 💿 The Journey to the Artifact
You can't just find this powerful artifact lying around; you must earn it through a legendary ocean quest:

* Defeat the Guardians: Search for Ocean Monuments and conquer the dangerous Elder Guardians. You need to defeat 3 Elder Guardians to collect 3 Broken Disc Pieces.
  
* Craft the Base Disc: Combine the 3 Broken Pieces in a crafting table to forge the standard Submerged Music Disc.
  
* Awaken the Magic: Combine the standard disc with a Heart of the Sea to unleash its true potential and create the Submerged (Awakened) music disc!

### 🌊 Awakened Disc Abilities (Right-Click to Activate)
When you hold the Awakened version of the disc and Right-Click in the air, you activate its ancient magic:

* Ocean's Blessing: Instantly grants you Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for 1 minute (1200 ticks), allowing you to swim swiftly and breathe effortlessly underwater.

* Audio Management: Smartly cuts off any overlapping music and plays the custom track cleanly.

* Cooldown System: The artifact goes on a 1-minute cooldown to prevent spamming and keep the gameplay balanced.

* Visual Aura: While the magic is active, a beautiful swirling aura of water bubble particles will appear around your body!

#### 🎵 Custom Soundtrack
Features a beautifully crafted, immersive ocean-themed track generated via Suno AI that plays perfectly in-game.

Created by sidyasinX using MCreator.
